notes.selection: per interval: max barrier_pct, then max abs(dev_twap_pct), then earliest timestamp
notes.fees: Polymarket crypto dynamic taker fee per share = 0.07*p*(1-p), charged at entry in both win and loss cases

notes.quality_filter: entry/resolution TWAP rows require twap and twap_open within 2% of concurrently logged oracle/open
